title: WP12-R R181 null-distribution calibration: the HEAD-vs-HEAD (identical-code) distribution of the median-form F1 parity statistics, CUDA and CPU
governing_ruling: R181 -- 'the parity oracle re-points to a statistic that is ZERO on identical code (the median form measures 0.000e+00 on all pairs -- it is the discriminating base), bounded by a null-calibrated envelope derived from the MEASURED HEAD-vs-HEAD distribution with stated margin; the null-distribution measurement commits as a pinned artifact and is the envelope's cited grounds (R69).'
predecessor: wp/WP12R/MEASUREMENT_BF1.md (same box, same fixtures, same instrument module)
what_a_pair_value_is: A NULL pair value is a parity statistic computed between the outputs of TWO RUNS OF IDENTICAL CODE -- same commit, same weights (torch.manual_seed(20260803)), same inputs, same fixture, same autocast regime. No seed and no input varies across runs or processes; the ONLY source of variation is CUDA kernel scheduling (index_add_ atomics). Any value a null pair attains is therefore attributable to the INSTRUMENT, not to a code change. An ALT pair value is the same statistic between an F1-patched run and a HEAD run (ordered: F1 in the treat position, HEAD in the reference position) and is the alternative distribution against which discrimination is judged.

sides.treat: arm (b)/(c): autocast(cuda, bfloat16) ENABLED -- the regime run5 trains in, and R181's discriminating base
sides.ref: arm (a): autocast DISABLED, all fp32 -- PREREG_DFIX §1's reference arm

statistic_definitions.policy_median_rel: median over elements of |X-Y| / (|Y| + 1e-3) on policy_logits (PREREG_DFIX OF1-3a's form)
statistic_definitions.bin_median_rel: the same on dist65 bin_logits (OF1-3c median)
statistic_definitions.policy_max_rel: max over elements of the same ratio on policy_logits (OF1-3b) -- carried here ONLY so its null can be exhibited
statistic_definitions.bin_max_rel: max form on bin_logits (OF1-3c max) -- same reason
statistic_definitions.grad_cos_f64: cosine similarity of flattened parameter-gradient vectors (OF1-4a), computed in float64
statistic_definitions.grad_cos_f32: the same in float32, as compare_bf1.py computes it -- reads > 1.0 on provably bit-identical tensors (accumulation error); reported so the float32 form's unsuitability is on the record
statistic_definitions.grad_cos_deficit_f64: 1 - grad_cos_f64; the quantity an envelope can bound

pair_value_convention: NULL pairs are unordered, so each statistic is computed in BOTH directions and the pair value is the MAX of the two (the MIN for the two cosine similarities). This is conservative for an upper envelope. ALT pairs are ORDERED (F1 treat, HEAD ref).

provenance.box: operator-granted remote GPU box (alias/provider/host deliberately not recorded here; see the dispatcher's own notes)
provenance.f1_patch_note: the same patch MEASUREMENT_BF1.md used; applied with `git apply` and reverted with `git apply -R`; the box tree was clean before and after (verified `git status --porcelain` empty, gine.py sha256 back to HEAD)
provenance.deterministic_algorithms: NOT enabled -- this measurement is OF the non-deterministic production regime; determinism would define the null away
provenance.seed_policy: weights torch.manual_seed(20260803); fixtures built on CPU generators with fixed seeds; NO seed varies across reps or processes -- the ONLY source of variation is kernel scheduling
provenance.process_structure: CUDA HEAD = 10 processes x 5 reps; CUDA F1 = 4 x 5; CPU HEAD = 10 x 2; CPU F1 = 5 x 2. Pairs are labelled within_process / cross_process so the pooling can be audited.
provenance.ordering_discipline: every raw arm dump existed on disk before any statistic was computed: null_probe.py writes ONLY tensors; null_compare.py is a separate process that reads them. First comparison postdates the last raw dump by 1 m 43 s.

fixtures_note: synth8 reproduces PREREG_DFIX §1's registered fixture. prod27_samesizes changes ONLY in-degree. prod27_run5shape is BF1-4's production-distribution proxy (run5's censused mean in-degree 26.783, p90 33, max 49). Identical to MEASUREMENT_BF1.md §6.0's three fixtures, byte for byte -- the same builder module was imported.

envelope_proposals._preamble: Three DIFFERENT things are called an 'envelope' in this WP and they are kept apart here. E1 is the NULL SELF-TEST: what identical code must produce, and it is what proves the oracle has a zero false-positive rate (LAW-07). E2 is the REPRODUCIBILITY envelope on a registered reading: how far a CI assertion's left-hand side may drift between runs. E3 is the DISCRIMINATION FLOOR: the value below which a reading carries no information. None of the three is the engineering PASS band -- that is a judgement about acceptable drift and the null cannot supply it. All values below are RECOMMENDATIONS; the dispatcher and architect rule.

cuda_policy_median_rel.assertion: median form of the bf16 arm, HEAD run i vs HEAD run j == 0.0 exactly
cuda_policy_median_rel.grounds: 3675 / 3675 pairs exactly 0.0 (1225 pairs x 3 fixtures), n_runs = 50
cuda_policy_median_rel.margin: not applicable -- the null is identically zero; a multiplicative margin over zero is vacuous and an exact assertion is strictly stronger

cpu_all_statistics.assertion: torch.equal(policy_logits), torch.equal(bin_logits), torch.equal(grads), and exact == on both loss scalars
cpu_all_statistics.grounds: 1140 / 1140 CPU pairs bit-identical on all three tensors and both scalars (190 pairs x 3 fixtures x 2 sides), n_runs = 20
cpu_all_statistics.caveat: 1 - cos computed in float64 reads 1.1102e-16 on prod27_run5shape even for BIT-IDENTICAL gradients (float64 rounding of the dot/norm ratio). An exact gradient assertion must be torch.equal, NEVER cos == 1.0.

quantisation_grounds_for_a_non_zero_vari.why: if the architect wants a non-zero threshold so a future torch build cannot break the test on a single element, it can be derived rather than guessed
quantisation_grounds_for_a_non_zero_vari.recommended_threshold_arithmetic: 1.0e-3 < min(2.1453e-3, 2.3119e-3, 2.3703e-3) / 2.14 -- i.e. it sits below HALF the smallest value the statistic can attain without being exactly zero, so it is operationally identical to '== 0' while tolerating a build whose |a| p50 halves
quantisation_grounds_for_a_non_zero_vari.empirical_check: no pair anywhere in this measurement -- 3675 null + 3000 alt -- produced a policy_median_rel in (0, 7.4900e-3). The observed values are 0 or >= 7.49e-3; 1.0e-3 sits in the empty gap.

E2_reading_reproducibility._what: how far the LEFT-HAND SIDE of a registered OF1-3/OF1-4 assertion moves between runs of unmodified code, measured over 50 independent CUDA runs per fixture (field per_run_oracle_spread)

OF1-3a_policy_median.arithmetic: margin 3 chosen because the worst observed max/p99 across every non-degenerate null cell is 1.422 and the worst max/p50 is 7.99; 3x the FULL observed spread clears both

OF1-3b_policy_max.verdict: UNUSABLE -- the reading's own run-to-run spread (4.03e-1) EXCEEDS the row's entire abort threshold (4.0e-1)

E3_discrimination_floor._what: margin x the measured null max, per statistic, on the WORST fixture; a reading at or below this floor carries no information about any code change

policy_median_rel.verdict: PERFECT -- floor is exactly zero, so the whole positive real line is resolvable

grad_cos_deficit_f64.margin_window: 1 < M < 3.84 (M is bounded ABOVE by alt_min/null_max on prod27_run5shape = 2.7627e-5 / 7.1952e-6 = 3.84; a larger M would swallow F1's own smallest reading)
grad_cos_deficit_f64.arithmetic: 2 x 1.1463e-5 = 2.2927e-5; the gap from there to the worst-fixture alt_min (2.7627e-5) is 1.20x -- narrow. On synth8 the same margin leaves 37.19x.
grad_cos_deficit_f64.verdict: USABLE BUT MARGINAL on the production fixture -- secondary row only

bin_median_rel.verdict: FAILS DISCRIMINATION on prod27_run5shape: 851/1000 F1-vs-HEAD pairs read exactly 0.0. A zero null is worthless if the alternative is also zero.

policy_loss_rel.verdict: FAILS DISCRIMINATION -- 39.7 % / 8.6 % / 4.8 % of alt pairs fall at or below the null max

policy_max_rel.verdict: the null EXCEEDS the row's own 4.0e-1 abort threshold by 2.33x. Measured false-positive rate on identical code: 24.82 % over ABORT, 55.18 % over the 1.5e-1 PASS envelope (prod27_run5shape, n = 1225).

bin_max_rel.verdict: 44.49 % / 74.20 % of identical-code pairs exceed the 1.5e-1 PASS envelope; alt_min (1.4722e-1) is BELOW null_max (3.1226e-1) on prod27_run5shape -- anti-discriminating
